# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi! I just moved from Florida over to Phoenix, so my account is probably still clinging to my old address like glitter after a craft project. 😅

I need to update my address on the account. My new address should already be on my most recent order, so if you can use that, that’d be perfect. I’d rather not type the full address out here.

My account name is **fatima_taylor_3452**. Old ZIP was **32169**, new ZIP is **85033**.

Also, while I’ve got you: what’s the **cheapest t-shirt** you have available right now, and can I place the order through you? I don’t remember the email on the account, because apparently my brain packed less efficiently than my moving boxes.

I can help with the address update and product info, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Per policy, I can’t use the user ID alone, and I also can’t place new orders. I can only help with account info, existing orders, and eligible order changes/returns/exchanges.

To authenticate you, please provide either:
- your email address, or
- your first name, last name, and ZIP code

Since you mentioned ZIPs, the easiest option is probably:
- first name
- last name
- either the old ZIP or new ZIP

Once you’re authenticated, I can:
- look up your most recent order
- check whether it has the new address
- update your default account address after you confirm
- tell you the cheapest available t-shirt currently in stock

But I cannot place a new order through chat.

Absolutely, let’s do the easy route before my memory files a workers’ comp claim.

**First name:** Fatima  
**Last name:** Taylor  
**ZIP code:** 85033

If that doesn’t work, you can also try the old one: **32169**.

And no worries on the order part — I figured I’d ask just in case you had secret shopping-superhero powers. 🦸‍♀️👕
